map.一端闭口、一端开口的管，基频波长为管长 4 倍。: A pipe closed at one end and open at the other has a fundamental wavelength four times the pipe length.
map.一端闭口管 f₁ = v/4L，仅含奇次谐波。: A pipe closed at one end has f1 = v/4L and contains only odd harmonics.
map.343 m/s、0.5 m 管约 171.5 Hz。: 343 m/s and a 0.5 m pipe give about 171.5 Hz.
map.📚 深度解析：闭管驻波频率: 📚 Deep Dive: Standing-wave frequencies in a closed pipe
map.一端闭一端开的管（如闭管乐器、瓶口）驻波频率 f_n=n·c/(4L)，n=1,: A pipe closed at one end and open at the other (e.g. closed-pipe instruments, bottle mouths) has standing-wave frequencies f_n=n·c/(4L), n=1,3,5...
map.计算闭管基频与奇次泛音。: Compute the closed-pipe fundamental and odd harmonics.
map.管风琴或教学演示中预测发声频率。: Predict the sounding frequency for pipe organs or teaching demos.
map.管长 L=0.34 m、声速 c=343 m/s，基频 f1=c/(4L)=34: With pipe length L=0.34 m and sound speed c=343 m/s, the fundamental f1=c/(4L)=343/1.36=252 Hz; only odd harmonics (3f1, 5f1...) are allowed.
map.为什么闭管只有奇次谐波？: Why does a closed pipe have only odd harmonics?
map.闭端必为声压波腹、开端为波节，边界条件只允许 n 取奇数，故缺失偶次泛音。: The closed end must be a pressure antinode and the open end a node, so the boundary condition allows only odd n and even harmonics are missing.
map.和开管有何不同？: How does it differ from an open pipe?
map.开管两端皆波节，f_n=n·c/(2L) 含全部整数谐波，基频比同长闭管高一倍。: An open pipe has nodes at both ends, f_n=n·c/(2L) with all integer harmonics, and its fundamental is twice that of a closed pipe of the same length.
